//: BN-native replacement for DDA base's parametrized_highrise_walls_palette (data/json/mapgen_palettes/common_parameters.json), which BN doesn't ship. MoM's phavian_skyscraper_office_palette includes it for the '|' interior-wall glyph (and '#' exterior, which the office palette itself overrides to t_concrete_wall). DDA randomized among 13 colored structural-concrete walls; BN has only the base t_strconc_wall (all t_strconc_wall_<color> variants are absent), which is exactly the fallback DDA used for both glyphs, so the appearance is faithful. Plain terrain map avoids depending on colored terrains BN lacks.
